title: Federer–Fleming closure theorem and boundary rectifiability (Simon 6.8.2–8.3, 6.6.3)
statement: (CL) For all P, d ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and currents T_j, T ∈ 𝒟_d(U): if every T_j is integer multiplicity, sup_j (M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open W with closure(W) compact and contained in U (∂-mass read as 0 when d = 0, contract boundaryMassOn), and T_j ⇀ T in U, then T is integer multiplicity. (BR) For all P, d ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and every integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) with M_W(∂R) < ∞ for every such W, the boundary ∂R is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: (∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) ∧ (∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity R → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → R.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → IsIntegerMultiplicity R.boundary)
